reasons.J: The tilted longship breaking out of a crown of pale shards, with the steep second hull, is the strongest subject on the sheet and the seeds now differ in pitch, but the gunwale light barely shows and the wreck crowds the road.
reasons.H: The hooded giants now read as lean silhouettes on the skyline from the road, and the ring snow has bigger flakes, but from the game camera they are small next to the court, the pool is a flat dark patch, and the three seeds are one layout.
reasons.D: The floor is now the brightest thing in the well, so the stepped rings draw the eye down from the game camera as the idea asked, but every seed has the same cross-shaped floor and diamond terraces, the rune stones are small, and the down-the-shaft shot is a flat pattern.
reasons.A: The rework turned a muddle of tan blocks into a clean black pool ringed by rounded sinter, glinting rim lights and a lit hill-fire, but the pool now reads as a squared basin in a square frame, not an irregular spring, every seed has the same layout, and all three 'in along the road' shots are empty or blocked.
reasons.C: The crack now runs at a slant, with deeper stepped dark walls, cold glints and a lit brazier at the bridge head, and the snow-spill set piece is denser, but the bridge's timber plug still fills the gap and the span shots are dark clutter.
reasons.F: The tongue now reads as one teal mass of fluted seracs against the dark granite, where before it was a grey-on-grey wall, and the road shots exist, but from above it is a rectangular slab of columns, the meltwater fall is invisible in the set piece, and the seeds barely change.

notes: Judged from the renders alone. The rework helped most of the set: A, C, D, E, F, G, H and J improved, while B and I held level. Three problems run across the board. First, the 'in along the road' camera comes back empty or blocked by a wall for most features (A, D, G, I, and seed 3 of nearly all), so that column carries no evidence. Second, the seeds vary too little: D, G, H and I are one layout repeated. Third, most features sit in a square frame that shows from the game camera. J, H and D bring silhouettes or light this game hasn't got and are the safest to keep. A and C are good-looking set dressing once their shapes loosen. F is usable as a backdrop wall. B, E and G are weaker, and I should be left off until its heaps and doors read.
